# Major Noor's Chilli & Mint Sauce
Firecracker Naga chilli blended with fresh mint. Inspired by Major Noor, an officer of the British Indian Army in the WWII Burma Campaign, recreated by his grandsons Imran and Abbas and first served at Rooster Shack restaurants.
Products: Chilli & Mint Sauce (from £4.99), Twin Sauce Pack (£8.99), 8 Bottle MultiPack (£29.99).
Shop: https://www.majornoors.com/product/chilli-mint-sauce/
Trade: enquiries@majornoors.com
10p from every bottle supports the Royal British Veterans Enterprise.
